title: Jr NTR Undergoes Successful Shoulder Surgery at KIMS Hyderabad
excerpt: The Dragon star's arthroscopic procedure at KIMS Hospitals follows a shoulder injury sustained during filming in late July
body:
• Jr NTR underwent arthroscopic shoulder surgery at KIMS Hospitals in Hyderabad on August 12, with his team confirming the procedure went smoothly
  • The actor sustained the shoulder injury in late July while filming an action sequence for his upcoming film Dragon, directed by Prashanth Neel
  • Dragon, a pan-Indian action thriller set in 1967 with Jr NTR as assassin Luger, also stars Anil Kapoor and is slated for a June 2027 release
  • Jr NTR thanked fans for their prayers and support, with his medical team expected to oversee a structured rehabilitation programme

Telugu superstar Jr NTR underwent arthroscopic shoulder surgery at KIMS Hospitals in Hyderabad on Tuesday, his team confirmed, marking a key step in his recovery from an injury sustained during the filming of his much-anticipated action thriller Dragon.

The procedure was performed following a detailed medical evaluation of the shoulder injury that had sidelined the actor from film sets for over two weeks. His team released a statement ahead of the surgery saying the team of doctors was "working towards a smooth recovery" and promised to keep fans updated on his progress.

Injury During Dragon Shoot

Jr NTR first sustained the shoulder injury on July 27 while shooting an intense action sequence for Dragon, directed by KGF and Salaar filmmaker Prashanth Neel. His medical team, led by Dr. J. Madhusudan Rao and Dr. R.A. Purnachandra Tejaswi, initially advised six to eight weeks of complete rest.

"We regret to inform everyone that Mr. NTR sustained an unfortunate shoulder injury earlier this evening. Following a thorough medical evaluation, the team of doctors has advised complete rest for six to eight weeks to ensure a smooth and complete recovery."

— Jr NTR's team, official statement

The injury was not his first setback on the Dragon sets. Earlier during production, he had suffered a sprain to his left wrist while working out, which kept him away from shooting for approximately four weeks. The repeated injuries prompted concern among fans, with some questioning whether the actor was performing stunts that should have been handled by body doubles.

What Is Dragon About?

Dragon is one of the most anticipated pan-Indian films currently in production. Set in 1967, the film explores the illegal international opium and heroin trade in the post-Independence era, spanning Afghanistan and the Golden Triangle of Southeast Asia.

Jr NTR plays Luger, a ruthless assassin-in-chief for the Afghan Trading Company, nicknamed Dragon, who finds himself navigating a treacherous underworld of rival cartels and law enforcement. The actor underwent a significant physical transformation for the role, shedding around 15 kilos to achieve the lean, intense look the character demands.

Bollywood veteran Anil Kapoor plays a Narcotics Bureau chief in the film, marking his return to Telugu cinema after 46 years. Rukmini Vasanth plays the female lead. The film is slated for a theatrical release on June 11, 2027.

Recovery and What's Next

Following the successful surgery, Jr NTR is expected to begin a structured rehabilitation programme. If recovery progresses as planned, he could resume shooting for Dragon by late September or October.

The actor also has Devara: Part 2 in his lineup, the follow-up to his 2024 action film, along with a mythology-inspired project with director Trivikram Srinivas. His team thanked fans, well-wishers, and the media for their support and requested privacy during his recovery.

A Wider Trend in Tollywood

Jr NTR's surgery adds to a string of health setbacks among top Telugu actors in recent months. His uncle Chiranjeevi underwent a minor keyhole shoulder surgery earlier this year. Pawan Kalyan, another prominent actor-politician in the family, had surgery for rotator cuff injuries in Mumbai. Nandamuri Balakrishna sustained a leg injury during filming in July, while Varun Tej fractured his knee in April during volleyball practice for a film.

Despite the setbacks, fans remain confident that Jr NTR will return stronger. The Dragon teaser, released on his birthday in May, generated massive excitement with its high-octane visuals and Prashanth Neel's signature cinematic style.
